features.name: climb_rate_z_clipped
features.description: Climb-rate deviation in training-fold standard-deviation units, clipped to reduce leverage from extreme vertical-speed values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear SVM a smooth, centered vertical-motion coordinate with stable scale.

features.name: vertical_accel_z_clipped
features.description: Vertical acceleration deviation in training-fold standard-deviation units, clipped for robust scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a signed acceleration coordinate that can align with vertical-state margins.

features.name: angular_rate_norm
features.description: Euclidean magnitude of standardized roll-rate and pitch-rate signals.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts two angular-rate coordinates into a continuous activity severity measure.

features.name: aerodynamic_attitude_norm
features.description: Combined standardized deviation of pitch, roll, absolute roll reference, and alpha.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes multi-axis attitude departure as one smooth severity axis.

features.name: lateral_rate_attitude_coupling
features.description: Signed product of standardized current roll and roll-rate, indicating whether lateral attitude and rotation reinforce or oppose each other.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a simple nonlinear coupling as a single continuous coordinate usable by a linear margin.

features.name: vertical_change_activity_norm
features.description: Magnitude of standardized first and second climb-rate change signals.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures abrupt vertical-state transitions that raw level measures may miss.

features.name: vertical_control_projection
features.description: Predefined weighted projection of current control command, climb rate, vertical acceleration, and pitch rate using training-fold scales.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a single smooth coordinate for coupled vertical-control behavior that can strengthen a linear margin.

features.name: control_command_history_gap
features.description: Current control command minus the mean of the fourteen recent control-time readings, scaled by the training-fold control-command spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures how far the current control setting deviates from its recent context on a normalized scale.
features.formula: np.clip((Se - ((SeTime1 + SeTime2 + SeTime3 + SeTime4 + SeTime5 + SeTime6 + SeTime7 + SeTime8 + SeTime9 + SeTime10 + SeTime11 + SeTime12 + SeTime13 + SeTime14) / 14.0)) / 0.0069863522735395195, -4.0, 4.0)

features.name: control_timing_trend_z
features.description: Difference between late and early recent control-time blocks, normalized by the training-fold control-command spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a signed trend feature that can reveal gradual drift in recent control timing.
features.formula: np.clip((((SeTime11 + SeTime12 + SeTime13 + SeTime14) / 4.0) - ((SeTime1 + SeTime2 + SeTime3 + SeTime4) / 4.0)) / 0.0069863522735395195, -4.0, 4.0)

features.name: control_timing_change_energy
features.description: Combined standardized magnitude of nonconstant recent control-time differences and roll-rate change.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses multiple small timing-change signals into one smooth activity measure.

features.name: aerodynamic_stability_semantic_score
features.description: Expert semantic score for overall aerodynamic steadiness using the row's climbRate, Sgz, p, q, curPitch, curRoll, absRoll, alpha, diffClb, diffRollRate, and diffDiffClb; 0.0 means calm and mutually consistent, 1.0 means strongly disturbed or contradictory.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact domain-synthesis axis that may capture interactions not present in individual formula features.

features.name: control_urgency_semantic_score
features.description: Expert semantic score for control urgency using the row's Se, SeTime1 through SeTime14, diffSeTime1 through diffSeTime14, and motion cues; 0.0 means routine low-effort adjustment, 1.0 means unusually abrupt or high-effort adjustment.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear SVM a human-interpretable control-context axis with bounded scale.
